messages:
amira: Heads up — product asked if we can expose per-tenant threshold visibility in the console. They want to hide internal-only thresholds from tenants while still surfacing aggregate SLO health. Thoughts? :eyes:

ben: Two parts: (1) UI visibility controls on the policy, (2) API flags so integrations can fetch admin-only ones. We should add `visibility: ADMIN|TENANT|SHARED` to alert policies.

devin: For routing & notifications, if a threshold is `ADMIN` we should NEVER fanout tenant contacts. But we may still want internal on-call. Need to ensure the notify service respects visibility during fanout decision.

marc: Agree. Also audit implications: admin-only still counts against global error budget math, right? Product wants to show tenant SLOs minus admin noise.

amira: They explicitly want tenant dashboards to exclude ADMIN policies from their error budget graphs. So we need separate aggregates: tenant_visible_errors vs internal_errors. Could be done at query time with `visibility` tag.

ben: API sketch:

```
{"alert_policy": {"id": "p-123", "thresholds": [{"op": "gt", "value": 5, "visibility": "ADMIN"}], "notify": {"contacts": ["#sre-team"], "tenant_notify": false}}}
```

devin: Implementation note: routing-service stores policy metadata. We should add a `visibility` enum and short-circuit fanout for TENANT vs ADMIN. Also add a `visibility_score` that reduces sampling for SHARED vs TENANT.

alertbot: deploy: feature-flag `slo.visibility_controls` enabled in staging :rocket:

marc: Telemetry: emit `console.slo.policy.visibility` with values and `slo.policy.tenant_excluded_count` for dashboards. We'll need to backfill counts for existing policies defaulting to SHARED.

amira: Migration plan: default existing policies to SHARED. Product will opt-in tenants to `hide_internal_thresholds` toggle. We'll need a small migration to add `visibility: SHARED` for all existing policies and a migration script to set tenant dashboards to filter when toggle is on.

ben: UX: show a small badge on each threshold row: "admin" or "tenant" and explain in tooltip. Keep it collapsed by default. Also add a bulk-edit flow.

devin: Edgecase: if a policy is ADMIN but also has a webhook for tenant integrations, we should validate and block that config. Add a linter in the API.

amira: OK I'll draft RFC and include API contract + migration steps + telemetry queries. Tagging @ben @devin @marc for review. Thanks! :+1:
